title: A recorded HEADWATER development cycle
question: Can soil conditions and nearby spatial information improve a weekly weather estimate?

plain_terms.root_zone_soil: Water held in the soil that plant roots can reach.
plain_terms.9x9: A small model reads a neighborhood of grid cells.
plain_terms.temperature_error: The typical size of an estimate’s temperature error; lower is better.

scope: A retrospective of existing records, not a new experiment. Development record dates in 2026 are separate from the forecast-valid weeks in 2019.
change: The recorded soil-input model uses a 9×9 first convolution and a 1×1 second convolution.

result.comparison_label: the 1979–2017 week already in the example files
result.score_scope: Temperature error across four 2019 target weeks; not an actual temperature or a single April score.
result.causal_scope: The 0.77 versus 0.86 comparison does not isolate the contribution of soil information alone.

conclusion: The recorded model improves the four-week temperature comparison; it still misses much of the April rain and does not improve every week.
next_decision: Use the recorded weaknesses to define one changed test. A person chooses the brief and approves any future execution.
date_note: Record dates below identify documentation, not job submission or completion times.

history.label: Data documented
history.record: The Frontier inventory lists 153 weekly examples and a copy containing root-zone soil information.
history.meaning: The recorded inputs were available for preparing the model test; this inventory is not a new file check.
history.next_decision: Use the recorded inputs and a written test design; review any additional data preparation.

history.label: Result recorded
history.record: The ledger marks det_v2_soil_k9 as scored: a soil-input model with a 9×9 first convolution and a 1×1 second convolution.
history.meaning: Its four-week 2019 valley temperature error is 0.7668 K. Rain remains near the stored comparison, and July is weaker.
history.next_decision: Keep the temperature result and remaining weaknesses together when designing a changed test.

history.label: Further tests reviewed
history.record: A saved Proposer, Critic, Referee and experiment pack contains several proposed follow-up tests.
history.meaning: A review pack exists, but these files do not establish which proposal a person selected as the current one-change brief.
history.next_decision: Identify one selected change and its approval before describing a current execution plan.

history.label: Demo record supplied
history.record: Dali attributes det_v2_soil_k9 to H100 / CCSI and records a four-week error of 0.77°C against 0.86°C for the 1979–2017 week already in the example files.
history.meaning: Lower error is better. This comparison is not an isolated measurement of the effect of soil information alone. The supplied H100 and Lux training flags are off.
history.next_decision: Explain the recorded result, show the remaining rain problem, and let a person choose the next reviewed test.
